hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; params=json.load(sys.stdin); path=params.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); blocked=['.vault_pass','.envrc','vars/vault.yml','.tfvars']; sys.exit(2) if any(b in path for b in blocked) else sys.exit(0)"

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */roles/*.y*ml|*/group_vars/*.y*ml|*/host_vars/*.y*ml|*/playbooks/*.y*ml|*/tasks/*.y*ml|*/handlers/*.y*ml|*/defaults/*.y*ml) out=$(ansible-lint "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | head -30 >&2; exit 2; } ;; *.tf) out=$(terraform fmt -check -diff "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
